events.credibility_reason: Status on the lean-eval page is contradictory ('declaration uses sorry' alongside 'All goals completed'), and the solver row comes from an unopened snippet.

why: No event touches the quadrisecant count of any wild knot. Kuperberg 1994 poses the conjecture (in its wild-arc form) and proves only the tame case, so it is none for this statement. Bai-Wang-Wang settles a different conjecture (quadrisecant approximation), which makes it a variant. The four post-2024 wild-knot preprints build or classify wild knots and never mention quadrisecants, so each is none. The lean-eval row is a formal statement of the known smooth-knot theorem, so it is a variant. It is undated, and no AI system is credited with anything on the page that was opened. None of these was a close call.
doubts: The wild-arc versus wild-knot wording question has no effect here, because no event settles either form. The record says a date-browsed search of arXiv math.GT for 'quadrisecant' plus 'wild' was not possible; that is the main gap in coverage.
